definition: For each patient compute (EZ-positive F1 + NEZ-positive F1)/2 on all original valid channels; then average patients equally. Not EZ-F1, pooled-channel F1, micro-F1, weighted-F1 or an equal-fold substitute.

reference.scope: historical frozen fivefold Outer, exploratory repeated-test
reference.development_scope: 65 patient appearances / 47 unique patients, checkpoint/threshold-selection conditioned; not independent validation
reference.evidence_status: Existing anonymous source tables read now; no new neural prediction replay or Outer evaluation in this clarification step.

future_optimization: Use Macro-F1-aligned loss and legal internal checkpoint/threshold/model selection. Preserve original patient-held-out roles, raw samples, masks, channels and seed42. No manual physiological feature inputs, no independent D1 branch. Report AUROC/AP/EZ-F1/NEZ-F1/ACC/MRR/Top1/bias and paired uncertainty alongside primary Macro-F1.
baseline_fidelity: Start from the actual matched Raw-only reference, not a weaker reinitialization silently substituted for it. Its 160D head has 96 active Raw coordinates and 64 zero physiological slots. Pure96 mapping must copy the active first-layer weights/bias and later layers, then pass actual validation prediction parity before use. Do not feed artificial descriptors merely because legacy constructor interfaces contain their slots.
historical_studies: The prior raw_latent_contrast and raw_information_retention studies were actually optimized for EZ-F1 under the agent's earlier interpretation. Preserve their frozen sources/results and negative findings. Do not retroactively change their selection rules or relabel their outcomes as Macro-F1-optimized experiments.
oracle_correction: The previously reported per-patient oracle threshold ceiling around0.57-0.58 maximizes EZ-F1 only. It is neither a Macro-F1 ceiling nor evidence that patient Macro-F1>0.65 is unreachable.
